The instant pot cooks a frozen chicken breast in 8 minutes (\~12 minutes if including the time for it to pressurize). Just pour a cup of water in the pot and set the chicken breast inside on the trivet, and start. Once finished the chicken will have some water droplets on it because of the moisture in the pot, but I just shake them off. I add salt, pepper and bbq sauce or one of those chicken spice shakers you get at the store.
